C1.原句: Each battery used 8 µL (E/S ratio around 5) of different electrolytes, with a Celgard 3401 membrane as the separator and lithium chip as the anodes.

比较.溶剂化依据: HPLC：1 M Li2S6 在 3FPy 中溶解度远高于 2FPy（总峰面积 4.8e7 vs 4.6e6，同篇实测）；CID 质谱：Li+ 与 2FPy 结合更强

指标.原句: Cycling stability tests indicate that both electrolytes exhibit a comparable capacity retention, with only 50-60% of the original capacity retained after 50 cycles at 0.05C.

比较.溶剂化依据: HPLC：3FPy 多硫化物溶解度高于 DME/DOL（同篇实测）

指标.原句: Comparative low-temper- ature performance results (Figure S-19) show that Li-S batteries with fluoropyridine electrolytes perform poorly at 0 °C, achieving specific discharge capacities of only 300 mAh g-1 (3FPy electrolyte) and 550 mAh g-1 (2FPy electrolyte) after 25 cycles.

比较.溶剂化依据: HPLC：2FPy 与 DME/DOL 多硫化物溶解度都较低（同篇实测）

指标.原句: In contrast, the Li-S battery with the DME/DOL electrolyte maintained a significantly higher discharge capacity of over 750 mAh g-1 under the same conditions, highlighting its superior low-temperature performance relative to fluoropyr- idine electrolytes.

备注: 宽温研究：作者称高温下需 LiNO3 抑制穿梭，低温下氟吡啶不如 DME/DOL。室温下与 DME/DOL 的直接比较数值未在文字中给出。多硫化物溶解度有同篇 HPLC 实测（可作公共刻度候选，但为纯溶剂、间接映射）。锂厚、DME/DOL 配方浓度未见。
